author: @mel
text:
Hi Hotochin,

The FTR you marked in yellow was already tested a few times, so for me there is no TT on a "unfresh" FTR.

If you want to TT , it's best to look from fresh FTR's, otherwise wait for a LTF engulfing at HTF zones.

On your last chart, you are marking the "range" high and low and now it
looks like some of the zones have been engulfed while it just reacted to
 previous FTR (same scenario as my last EU trade) .

I would say, take this feedback and go study it in more deepth, you're almost there.

Best,

Mel

author: @mel
text:
Thanks Fxfury and TTfreitas, feel free to "poluate" as much as you want :)

Rexed,

1) You could have scalped that pink box as it was a fresh FTR aswell, in
 fact there was a beautifull setup on m5 good for 25 pips. The target
was met and you couldn't expect more for this setup as it was trading
into the fresh lower FTR.

2) This was an FTR, very clear "shape" on h1, you can see that the
demand there was ignored . Do you see my upper purple line? extend it a
bit to the left, you'll see it was ignored supply and ignored demand, a
good place for price to get into.

Hope this helps,

Mel
